scope: Actual pinned Nordic critical-region C bodies; raw NVIC write order/value, masks, nested byte, PRIMASK, preserved registers/stack, repeated nesting and unmapped writes; no provider interceptions
limitations: NVIC registers are a deterministic mapped register model; real interrupt delivery and hardware alias semantics are not exercised.
Void return scratch registers and original instruction identity are outside this contract.
No physical-device, whole-image or cycle-timing proof.
